title: Cost it, price it, sell it honestly, finish your project

say: Cost it, price it, sell it honestly, and finish your project.
This is the video for module 4 of Organic Skincare and Hair Products.
Many makers price by looking at what others charge. If you do not know your own cost, you may sell every jar at a loss without noticing.

say: First, find the cost per gram. If you paid 4,000 naira for 1,000 g of shea butter, it costs 4 naira per gram. Multiply by the grams you use, for every ingredient.

panel.heading: The four layers of cost
items: Ingredients: grams used times cost per gram
Packaging: jar, lid, label
Labour: your hours at a fair rate
Overheads: gas, sanitiser, gloves, data

say: Add packaging: the jar, lid and label.

panel.heading: The four layers of cost

say: Add labour. Time a real batch, from setting up to washing up. Labour is the cost new makers most often leave out. If you do not pay yourself, you cannot hire help later.

say: Overheads are about 800, and 2 hours of labour at 1,000 naira an hour is 2,000.

card.title: Costing five jars of whipped shea

say: The full batch costs 13,750 naira. Divided by 5 jars, that is 2,750 naira per jar, before any profit.

say: Multiply the full unit cost by a markup. At 1.8 times, Kemi's price is about 4,950 naira, which she rounds to 5,000.

Compare with the market

panel.rule: Never discount below your full unit cost.

say: Then give proof from your own testers. Six testers used it twice a week for four weeks, and most found it light.
Promise softness, shine and moisture, never cures or guaranteed growth. Photograph in daylight with the label readable, and state the price clearly.

say: Even with patch testing, some people will react. Reply quickly and kindly. Ask her to stop using it and wash it off gently.

panel.heading: When a customer reacts
items: Reply quickly; stop use, wash off gently
Severe or spreading: see a health worker
Ask for batch number and photo; record it
Check batch record and retained sample
Refund or replace, then follow up

say: Your capstone is one hair product. Esther in Jos made an unscented sealing oil, tested it with six women of different hair types for four weeks, and reduced castor from 40% to 35%.
Check your folder has every item here. Keep 90-day targets small and real. It is better to plan 20 sales and achieve 25 than to plan 500 and give up.

panel.heading: Before you submit
items: Formula in percentages, grams and reasons
Dilution within range, or unscented
Skin test and user trial evidence
Batch record and costing sheet
Honest label, no medical claims
90-day plan with dates and measures

say: To remember. Count all four layers of cost, price from your cost, and never discount below it. Describe products in five honest parts.
And your certificate is not a NAFDAC registration. Use your Module 3 research to plan that step.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Ingredients, packaging, labour, overheads
Price from cost, then check the market
Never discount below full cost
What, ingredients, who, how, proof
The certificate is not a NAFDAC registration
